items.title: Re-vendor LibKa0s v1.71.0 from the local tag, with the v1.71.0 bundle and the unrecorded v1.69.0-v1.70.0 span bundle
items.spec: Mechanical re-vendor, one commit. (1) Payloads: rm -rf libs/LibKa0s tests/_kit, then copy ../LibKa0s/LibKa0s/ -> libs/LibKa0s/ and ../LibKa0s/testkit/ -> tests/_kit/ WHOLE from the LOCAL tag v1.71.0 (git -C ../LibKa0s archive v1.71.0 LibKa0s testkit | tar -x into a scratch dir, then copy; keep the runner executable bits). No edit under libs/ or tests/_kit/ beyond the copy. (2) CLAUDE.md provenance line 'Bundles [LibKa0s](...) v1.70.0 (MIT).' -> v1.71.0. (3) docs/testing.md:187 version-now sentence ("`../LibKa0s` sits on **v1.68.1**, CLAUDE.md names the same tag", already stale since v1.69.0/v1.70.0): de-tag it so it no longer names a version (state the relationship: the checkout and the CLAUDE.md tag agree only between a re-vendor and the library's next tag), per KC-A-01's verdict; it must not rot on the next re-vendor. (4) Kit revision 38 (LK-01) delivers KC-A-07: regenerate docs/test-cases.md in THIS commit with lua tests/run.lua --list; its Total must now equal the README badge's passing count (1302 today) and a '| Skipped | 1 |' row must list the diagnostics opt-out declared skip (tests/test_diagnostics_contract via the kit). The badge itself does not move unless the case count changed. Do not make case registration host-dependent and make no local edit to the inventory. (5) Bundle docs/revendor/<date>-v1.71.0/ (date = the commit day) written by hand following the LOCAL ../dev-copilot wow-revendor-libka0s procedure run non-interactively: 01_DELTA.md whose line 1 is exactly 'Delta: LibKa0s v1.70.0 -> v1.71.0' (base from the CLAUDE.md provenance line, confirmed against the payload bytes), per-file LibStub minors old/new (WidgetsLineChart 3, WidgetsAutocomplete 2, Slash key 20.2, Env 2, OptionsIdList 4 per LK-03..LK-06), both payload diffs summarized, kit revision pairing 37 -> 38, the majors KickCD consumes, and contract changes under unchanged signatures (Slash ParseValue now refuses nan/inf: delivered free to /kcd set, class A; kit --list Totals semantics: delivered free, closes KC-A-07). 02_CANDIDATES.md lists the new surfaces (Kit.secret and the opt-in issecretvalue installer, LineChart clipping/hover, Autocomplete re-hook guard) each as 'not adopted in this run' (OWNER_SCOPE ruling 5): no interview, no GitHub issue. 05_SUMMARY.md: delivered free / candidates / adopted none / declined none / gate numbers after the copy. (6) Span bundle for the unrecorded re-vendors da8a8b8 (v1.69.0) and 9d4a10b (v1.70.0): docs/revendor/<date>-v1.69.0-v1.70.0/ with 01_DELTA.md line 1 exactly 'Delta: LibKa0s v1.69.0 -> v1.70.0 (span: v1.69.0 v1.70.0)', base v1.68.1 named in the body, per-tag minors and kit revisions from git -C ../LibKa0s diff v1.68.1 v1.69.0 / v1.69.0 v1.70.0, both vendoring commits cited as KickCD@<sha>, WidgetsAutocomplete named as a possible Spells add-box candidate (a note, not an adoption, no issue); and 05_SUMMARY.md with one line per tag: carried by sweep, nothing adopted. Shape matches docs/revendor/2026-10-01-v1.64.0-v1.65.0/. If the new library or kit turns the suite red, fix nothing addon-side here: record each failure in the commit body; the M3 items clear them and KC-STD is green at the latest.

items.title: Cast bar drops a stale primary-icon anchor when the icon grid empties
items.spec: modules/Castbar_Events.lua Castbar:OnGridLayout (~:250-:255): the payload is the full layout announcement, so cache primaryIcon UNCONDITIONALLY: inst.lastGridLayout.primaryIcon = payload.primaryIcon (nil included). IconGrid announces primaryIcon = nil for an empty grid (modules/IconGrid.lua announceLayout(inst, nil, ...) at ~:495) and the old 'only cache when populated' guard kept a pooled button that IconGrid had released (ClearAllPoints + Hide), so Castbar:ApplyAnchor (modules/Castbar_Frame.lua:142) in PRIMARY mode kept anchoring to an orphan and never reached resolveGridFrame. gridFrame stays guarded (an announcement always carries it). Rewrite the misleading 'Defensive: only cache when the field is actually populated' comment to say why primaryIcon is copied verbatim (nil = no primary icon, so ApplyAnchor falls back to the grid frame) and why gridFrame keeps its guard. Also refresh the resolveGridFrame/resolvePrimaryIcon comments in modules/Castbar.lua (~:208, :218) that call the payload cache 'preferred' if they imply a nil is never cached.
items.steps: 1. Red first: in tests/test_castbar_frame.lua (or tests/test_castbar.lua) add 'an empty grid announcement drops the cached primary icon and anchors to the grid frame' with a '-- red under: Castbar_Events.lua guarding primaryIcon ~= nil' line: load, enable target castbar with anchorMode PRIMARY, call Castbar:OnGridLayout('Ka0s_KickCD_GridLayout', {unit='target', gridFrame=G, primaryIcon=btnA}), assert the bar's SetPoint relativeTo is btnA; then OnGridLayout with {unit='target', gridFrame=G, primaryIcon=nil} and stub IconGrid:GetPrimaryIcon to return nil; assert inst.lastGridLayout.primaryIcon == nil and the last SetPoint relativeTo is G. Red on HEAD (still btnA). 2. Add a focus-payload case: a focus announcement never touches the target cache. 3. Make the one-line fix and rewrite the comment. 4. Gate; regenerate docs/test-cases.md and the badge.

items.title: Cast-bar name truncation counts UTF-8 characters, not bytes
items.spec: Option B (verdict): modules/Castbar.lua gains a file-local utf8Prefix(s, cap) mirroring MultiMeters/modules/Row_NameCell.lua utf8Truncate (walk bytes, count every byte outside 0x80-0xBF as a character start, return s:sub(1, i-1) at the (cap+1)th start, else s). truncateName (:335) keeps its nil/0/secret short-circuits, then: local cut = utf8Prefix(name, maxChars); if cut == name return name; else return cut .. '…'. A name of exactly maxChars characters is never truncated, whatever its byte length. Rewrite the stale header comment (:320-:334): length is counted in characters (UTF-8 lead bytes), a cut never splits a code point, pure Lua because strlenutf8 is absent from the headless harness, and never called on a secret. No LibKa0s helper (two call sites; promote only if LibKa0s already cuts a release for other reasons, which LK-12 does not plan). settings/Castbar.lua:436 label 'Truncate after (characters)' is now accurate and stays.

Existing ASCII cases stay green; secret pass-through case unchanged. 4. items.title: Glow gate tracks any target cast so the target_casting glow trigger follows friendly casts
items.spec: Decision (session lead, autonomous): the 'target_casting' glow trigger means ANY cast by the unit, the same meaning the same-named visibility mode already has (IconGrid_Visibility.lua shouldBeVisible: mode 'target_casting' -> instanceCasting(inst); settings label 'When target is casting'); 'target_casting_interruptible' stays hostile-only. So the trigger (modules/IconGrid_Render.lua triggerSatisfied :451, inst.isCasting()) is correct and the GATE is fixed: modules/IconGrid_Visibility.lua IconGrid:RefreshAllGlows computes a third scalar `local anyCasting = hostileCasting or IconGrid.InstanceCasting(inst)` (no extra API call when hostile casting is already true); gateMoved(inst, hostileCasting, interruptible, anyCasting) also compares inst.lastGateAnyCasting; the cache write stores all three scalars (no table, anti-pattern #43 unchanged). Update the RefreshAllGlows doc comment (~:233-:249) to name the three gate inputs and why the raw cast state is in it, and the defaults/Profile.lua glow-trigger comment (~:121-:131) to say 'target_casting' = any cast, friendly or hostile. docs/icon-grid.md glow-gate paragraph likewise. Keep RefreshAllGlows and gateMoved at CCN <= 15; the glowGate perf bracket is unchanged in shape.

items.title: /kcd debug: an unknown word refuses without toggling the console; castbar and interrupt take an optional target|focus unit
items.spec: core/KickCD.lua. (1) Split the sub-verb list printer out of runDebug's bare branch into a file-local printDebugList(self) (prints 'debug subcommands' plus NS.Slash.CommandRows('/kcd debug', DEBUG_COMMANDS, '  ')). The bare `/kcd debug` keeps its sanctioned behaviour (toggle the console, debug-logging-§5, then printDebugList). The unknown-word path becomes refuse(...) then printDebugList(self): it no longer re-enters runDebug(self, '') so it never toggles the console. (2) runDebug passes the remainder after the sub-verb to the handler: entry[3](self, remainder). A file-local parseDebugUnit(word) accepts '' -> 'target', 'target', 'focus' (case-insensitive) and returns nil otherwise. The castbar row calls m:DebugDump(unit) and the interrupt row NS.Compat.DebugInterrupt(unit); an unrecognized unit word refuses ('unknown unit '<w>', expected target or focus') through the existing refuse helper and runs nothing. Help strings: 'Print a unit's cast bar state (target by default, or focus)' and the interrupt row likewise names '[target|focus]'. Other rows ignore the remainder. runDebug stays at CCN <= 15. (3) Docs: docs/debug.md '/kcd debug castbar' (:277) and '/kcd debug interrupt' (:290) sections show the optional unit, docs/slash-dispatch.md's debug rows and README's command list if it names these verbs. Standard basis: slash-commands and debug-logging-§5 already sanction both the bare toggle and a usage reply.
items.steps: 1. Add: '/kcd debug castbar focus dumps the focus bar' (spy Castbar:DebugDump, assert arg 'focus'); '/kcd debug castbar' still passes 'target'; '/kcd debug interrupt focus' calls Compat.DebugInterrupt('focus'); '/kcd debug interrupt bogus' refuses and calls nothing. All but the default case red on HEAD. 3. Implement printDebugList, the remainder pass-through and parseDebugUnit; update help strings. 4. tests/test_slash_style.lua and any help-row snapshot tests updated to the new strings. 5. Docs. 6. Gate; regenerate docs/test-cases.md and the badge.

items.title: Util.Throttle reuses a frozen empty-args sentinel for zero-argument calls
items.spec: core/Util.lua Util.Throttle (:170-:215): hoist a file-scope `local EMPTY_ARGS = { n = 0 }` (never mutated; fire() only reads args.n and unpack) and set `local n = select('#', ...); pendingArgs = n == 0 and EMPTY_ARGS or { n = n, ... }`. Cooldowns' Refresh throttle (modules/Cooldowns.lua:645, called with no args on SPELL_UPDATE_COOLDOWN / _USABLE / _CHARGES) then allocates nothing per event. The per-burst args guarantee for calls WITH arguments is unchanged. Update the 'pendingArgs is a fresh table per burst' comment to name the zero-arg sentinel and why it is safe. No perf scenario required (verdict).
